Director Steven Spielberg and actors Colman Domingo, Emily Blunt, and Josh O’Connor join Fandango correspondent Nikki Novak to talk about their new film, ‘Disclosure Day’!  Spielberg digs into why the film is so personal for him, Domingo describes the “in your face” style of the movie, and Blunt shares the excitement and challenges of the action while filming the movie.  ‘Disclosure Day’ hits theaters June 12!
